title: Semi-supervised Concordance Learning for Optimal Individual Treatment Regimes
summary: Finding the optimal individualized treatment rule that maps individual characteristics or contextual information to treatment assignments has been extensively investigated in existing literature, with widespread practical applications. This paper considers the estimation of optimal treatment regimes within a semi-supervised data framework (exemplified by electronic medical record data).
